analysis.scoreReason: RSI 과매도 진입, MACD 악화 지속
analysis.scoreReasonEn: RSI enters oversold, MACD continues to worsen
analysis.reason: 최근 3거래일 연속 관망 유지. RSI 34.9 → 32.6으로 과매도 구간 진입, MACD 히스토그램은 -255.7355로 악화 지속. 5일 저가 23,720원 대비 현재가 25,095원으로 반등 시도하나 20일 고가 37,470원 대비 5일 고가 31,960원으로 Lower High 패턴이 강화되며 약세 추세 지속. ADX 25.6로 뚜렷한 추세는 유지되나 -DI 39.3이 +DI 16.3을 크게 상회하며 하락 압력 우위. 52주 저가 16,760원 대비 20.9% 위치로 추가 하락 여력 존재. 스윙 지지선 25,055원 근접.
analysis.reasonEn: Maintained a wait-and-see approach for 3 consecutive trading days. RSI moved from 34.9 to 32.6, entering oversold territory, and MACD histogram worsened to -255.7355. While the current price of 25,095 KRW attempts a rebound from the 5-day low of 23,720 KRW, the 5-day high of 31,960 KRW remains below the 20-day high of 37,470 KRW, reinforcing the Lower High pattern and continuing the downtrend. ADX at 25.6 indicates a clear trend, but the -DI at 39.3 significantly exceeds the +DI at 16.3, showing downward pressure dominance. At 20.9% of its 52-week low of 16,760 KRW, there is room for further decline. Approaching the swing support at 25,055 KRW.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (25,095 KRW) vs SMA5 (28,744 KRW) / SMA20 (30,066 KRW) / SMA50 (34,070 KRW): Below, indicating weak short-to-medium term trend position.
· Significantly below SMA100 (37,166 KRW) / SMA200 (36,409 KRW): Weakening long-term trend strength.
· 52-week position (20.9%): Current price level is historically low, suggesting room for further decline.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (43.1→32.6): Entering oversold territory, strengthening downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (94.7976→-255.7355): Continued worsening, signaling maintenance of the downtrend.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band at 25,387 KRW): Approaching the lower band, potential for further decline.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support line (25,055 KRW): Close to Pivot S1 (20,053 KRW), a key support zone.
· Swing resistance line (30,570 KRW): Potential for a short-term rebound if broken.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Lower High): Confirms continuation of the downtrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.31x): Movement is gaining strength, increasing confidence in the downtrend.
· Current phase diagnosis (Downtrend): Maintain a wait-and-see approach, consider buying near the swing support at 25,055 KRW.
